commands.longDescription: Trade real US stocks using economy coins. Buy fractional shares of real companies, track your portfolio value, and compete for profit. Stock prices are fetched live from the market, so your investments fluctuate with real market conditions.

options.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL)

subcommands.name: quote
subcommands.description: Get the current price of a stock
